# 学术论文

按语言和用途选 1–2 项，需要语境再读正文。副本是已保存版本，摘要不是全文。

- [Ten Simple Rules for Structuring Papers](https://journals.plos.org/ploscompbiol/article?id=10.1371/journal.pcbi.1005619) — 围绕中心贡献，用“背景—内容—结论”组织科学论文；适合研究论文的结构修改，仍须遵守学科和期刊规范。[正文](https://journals.plos.org/ploscompbiol/article?id=10.1371/journal.pcbi.1005619) · [Markdown 正文](../articles/ten-simple-rules-structuring-papers.md)

  **规则：** 按逐步支持中心贡献的逻辑组织结果小节，为各项判断配数据和图表，而不是照实验日期排列。[出处](https://journals.plos.org/ploscompbiol/article?id=10.1371/journal.pcbi.1005619)

- [Organizing Literature Reviews: The Basics](https://writingcenter.gmu.edu/writing-resources/research-based-writing/organizing-literature-reviews-the-basics) — 乔治梅森大学写作中心的综述指南：围绕研究问题比较文献，把提纲写成有证据支持的判断；不替代系统综述的方法规范。[正文](https://writingcenter.gmu.edu/writing-resources/research-based-writing/organizing-literature-reviews-the-basics) · [Markdown 摘要（非全文）](../articles/organizing-literature-reviews.md)

  **规则：** 按研究问题把不同文献的观点归组，再把主题标签改写成由该组证据支持的判断句。[出处](https://writingcenter.gmu.edu/writing-resources/research-based-writing/organizing-literature-reviews-the-basics)

- [Ten Simple Rules for Writing a Response to Reviewers](https://journals.plos.org/ploscompbiol/article?id=10.1371/journal.pcbi.1005730) — 英文期刊返修的逐点回复指南，区分审稿意见、回应和稿件改动；仍须遵守目标期刊要求，不得虚构补做的实验。[正文](https://journals.plos.org/ploscompbiol/article?id=10.1371/journal.pcbi.1005730) · [Markdown 正文](../articles/response-to-reviewers.md)

  **规则：** 保留审稿意见原文，逐点回应；一条意见含两个独立问题时，拆开分别回答。[出处](https://journals.plos.org/ploscompbiol/article?id=10.1371/journal.pcbi.1005730)

- [Ten Simple Rules for Writing a Paper about Scientific Software](https://journals.plos.org/ploscompbiol/article?id=10.1371/journal.pcbi.1008390) — 科学软件论文的写作指南，区分研究贡献、使用教程和版本文档；主要面向计算研究，不替代软件评测或复现证据。[正文](https://journals.plos.org/ploscompbiol/article?id=10.1371/journal.pcbi.1008390) · [Markdown 正文](../articles/scientific-software-papers.md)

  **规则：** 论文正文写研究问题、算法创新和结果；超过几句的使用教程移到附录或与论文版本对应的文档。[出处](https://journals.plos.org/ploscompbiol/article?id=10.1371/journal.pcbi.1008390)

- [Reviewing Academic Papers](https://github.com/jtleek/reviews) — Jeff Leek 的审稿写作指南，区分主要问题、次要问题和笔误；源于研究组惯例，评审标准仍以目标期刊为准。[副本·正文](../jtleek/reviews/README.md)

  **规则：** 每条主要批评都指向具体图表、段落或结果，写清问题所在，不只说“论证不充分”。[出处](https://github.com/jtleek/reviews/blob/master/README.md)
